items.question: Trong câu "You need not be a sysadmin, but you must understand the mechanisms that decide how a process starts, stops, gets resources and fails", từ "mechanism" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You need not be a sysadmin, but you must understand the mechanisms that decide how a process starts, stops, gets resources and fails", what does "mechanism" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: mechanism /ˈmekənɪzəm/ (danh từ): cơ chế vận hành. "Understand the mechanisms" = hiểu cơ chế bên trong quyết định cách tiến trình chạy và lỗi.
items.explanationEn: mechanism /ˈmekənɪzəm/ (noun): the way something works. "Understand the mechanisms" means knowing the internal workings that decide how a process runs and fails.

items.question: Trong câu "they surface as architecture problems: lost requests on deploy", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "they surface as architecture problems: lost requests on deploy", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to cover with a top layer
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɜːfɪs/ (động từ): lộ ra, nổi lên. "Surface as X" = lộ ra dưới dạng X; danh từ "surface" nghĩa là bề mặt.
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɜːfɪs/ (verb): to appear or become visible. "Surface as X" means to show up in the form of X; the noun "surface" means the outer layer.

items.question: Trong câu "Applications never touch hardware directly; they ask the kernel through system calls", từ "directly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Applications never touch hardware directly; they ask the kernel through system calls", what does "directly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: directly /dəˈrektli/ (trạng từ): một cách trực tiếp. Ứng dụng không chạm phần cứng trực tiếp mà phải đi qua kernel.
items.explanationEn: directly /dəˈrektli/ (adverb): without anything in between. Applications do not touch hardware directly; they go through the kernel instead.

items.question: Trong câu "Key point for later: containers are not a separate technology — they are ordinary Linux processes wrapped with kernel features", từ "ordinary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Key point for later: containers are not a separate technology — they are ordinary Linux processes wrapped with kernel features", what does "ordinary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ordinary /ˈɔːdnri/ (tính từ): bình thường, thông thường. "Ordinary process" = tiến trình bình thường, không có gì đặc biệt.
items.explanationEn: ordinary /ˈɔːdnri/ (adjective): normal, not special. An "ordinary process" is a normal one with nothing special about it.

items.question: Trong câu "Key point for later: containers are not a separate technology — they are ordinary Linux processes wrapped with kernel features", từ "wrap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Key point for later: containers are not a separate technology — they are ordinary Linux processes wrapped with kernel features", what does "wrap" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: wrap /ræp/ (động từ): bọc, bao quanh. "Wrapped with X" = được bọc bởi X; trong lập trình hay gặp "wrapper" (lớp bọc).
items.explanationEn: wrap /ræp/ (verb): to enclose or cover. "Wrapped with X" means enclosed by X; in programming you often meet "wrapper".

items.question: Trong câu "It adopts orphaned processes and must reap exited children.", từ "adopt" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It adopts orphaned processes and must reap exited children.", what does "adopt" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to take as your own child
items.explanation: adopt /əˈdɒpt/ (động từ): nhận nuôi, nhận về. Ở đây "adopt" là nhận nuôi tiến trình mồ côi; nghĩa khác phổ biến là "adopt a practice" (áp dụng).
items.explanationEn: adopt /əˈdɒpt/ (verb): to take as your own child. Here "adopt" means taking in orphaned processes; another common sense is "adopt a practice".

items.question: Trong câu "It adopts orphaned processes and must reap exited children.", từ "orphaned" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It adopts orphaned processes and must reap exited children.", what does "orphaned" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: orphaned /ˈɔːfənd/ (tính từ): mồ côi, mất cha mẹ. "Orphaned process" = tiến trình mà tiến trình cha đã kết thúc.
items.explanationEn: orphaned /ˈɔːfənd/ (adjective): having lost its parent. An "orphaned process" is one whose parent process has already exited.

items.question: Trong câu "It adopts orphaned processes and must reap exited children.", từ "reap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It adopts orphaned processes and must reap exited children.", what does "reap" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reap /riːp/ (động từ): thu dọn, thu hồi. "Reap a child" = thu hồi tiến trình con đã thoát; nghĩa gốc là gặt lúa.
items.explanationEn: reap /riːp/ (verb): to collect and clean up. "Reap a child" means collecting an exited child process; the original sense is harvesting crops.

items.question: Trong câu "A zombie holds no memory, only a process-table slot; you cannot kill it because it is already dead.", từ "slot" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A zombie holds no memory, only a process-table slot; you cannot kill it because it is already dead.", what does "slot" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: slot /slɒt/ (danh từ): ô, vị trí trong bảng. "A table slot" = một ô trong bảng; "time slot" = khung giờ.
items.explanationEn: slot /slɒt/ (noun): a position in a table. "A table slot" is one position in a table; "time slot" means a period of time.

items.question: Trong câu "A signal is an asynchronous notification sent to a process.", từ "asynchronous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A signal is an asynchronous notification sent to a process.", what does "asynchronous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: asynchronous /eɪˈsɪŋkrənəs/ (tính từ): bất đồng bộ. Signal bất đồng bộ nghĩa là có thể đến bất cứ lúc nào, không theo nhịp của tiến trình.
items.explanationEn: asynchronous /eɪˈsɪŋkrənəs/ (adjective): not coordinated in time. An asynchronous signal can arrive at any moment, independent of what the process is doing.

items.question: Trong câu "A signal is an asynchronous notification sent to a process.", từ "notification" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A signal is an asynchronous notification sent to a process.", what does "notification" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: notification /ˌnəʊtɪfɪˈkeɪʃn/ (danh từ): lời thông báo. "Send a notification" = gửi thông báo; động từ là "notify".
items.explanationEn: notification /ˌnəʊtɪfɪˈkeɪʃn/ (noun): a message that informs. "Send a notification" means to inform someone; the verb is "notify".

items.question: Trong câu "Graceful shutdown is a contract between the platform and your code.", từ "graceful" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Graceful shutdown is a contract between the platform and your code.", what does "graceful" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: graceful /ˈɡreɪsfl/ (tính từ): êm, có trật tự. "Graceful shutdown" = tắt êm, xử lý xong việc rồi mới thoát.
items.explanationEn: graceful /ˈɡreɪsfl/ (adjective): smooth and orderly. "Graceful shutdown" means stopping cleanly after finishing current work.

items.question: Trong câu "Graceful shutdown is a contract between the platform and your code.", từ "contract" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Graceful shutdown is a contract between the platform and your code.", what does "contract" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: contract /ˈkɒntrækt/ (danh từ): thỏa thuận ràng buộc. Trong kỹ thuật, "contract" là cam kết hai bên cùng tuân theo, như "API contract".
items.explanationEn: contract /ˈkɒntrækt/ (noun): a binding agreement. In engineering, a "contract" is an agreement both sides follow, as in "API contract".

items.question: Trong câu "systemctl stop, docker stop and Kubernetes all send SIGTERM first, wait for a grace period, then send SIGKILL", từ "grace period" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "systemctl stop, docker stop and Kubernetes all send SIGTERM first, wait for a grace period, then send SIGKILL", what does "grace period" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: grace period /ɡreɪs ˈpɪəriəd/ (cụm từ): thời gian chờ ân hạn. "Wait for a grace period" = chờ một khoảng thời gian cho phép trước khi buộc dừng.
items.explanationEn: grace period /ɡreɪs ˈpɪəriəd/ (phrase): extra time before enforcement. "Wait for a grace period" means allowing some time before forcing a stop.

items.question: Trong câu "Running the app through sh -c makes it worse, because the shell does not forward signals.", từ "forward" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Running the app through sh -c makes it worse, because the shell does not forward signals.", what does "forward" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: forward /ˈfɔːwəd/ (động từ): chuyển tiếp. "Forward signals/emails" = chuyển tiếp tín hiệu/thư đến nơi khác.
items.explanationEn: forward /ˈfɔːwəd/ (verb): to pass on. "Forward signals/emails" means passing them on to another recipient.

items.question: Trong câu "When a process dies from a signal, shells and container runtimes report exit code 128 + signal number: 137 = SIGKILL (often the OOM killer or an expired grace period)", từ "expire" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a process dies from a signal, shells and container runtimes report exit code 128 + signal number: 137 = SIGKILL (often the OOM killer or an expired grace period)", what does "expire" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expire /ɪkˈspaɪə/ (động từ): hết hạn. "An expired grace period" = thời gian ân hạn đã hết; hay gặp "token expired".
items.explanationEn: expire /ɪkˈspaɪə/ (verb): to come to an end. "An expired grace period" is one that has run out; compare "the token has expired".

items.question: Trong câu "Linux has one tree rooted at /; disks and network volumes are mounted into it.", từ "mount" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Linux has one tree rooted at /; disks and network volumes are mounted into it.", what does "mount" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mount /maʊnt/ (động từ): gắn vào hệ thống. "Mount a volume" = gắn ổ đĩa vào cây thư mục; ngược lại là "unmount".
items.explanationEn: mount /maʊnt/ (verb): to attach to a system. "Mount a volume" means attaching a disk to the directory tree; the opposite is "unmount".

items.question: Trong câu "Linux has one tree rooted at /; disks and network volumes are mounted into it.", từ "root" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Linux has one tree rooted at /; disks and network volumes are mounted into it.", what does "root" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to pull out by the roots
items.explanation: root /ruːt/ (động từ): có gốc tại. "Rooted at X" = bắt đầu (có gốc) từ X.
items.explanationEn: root /ruːt/ (verb): to have its base at. "Rooted at X" means having X as its starting point.

items.question: Trong câu "Virtual filesystems exposing kernel and process state — not on disk", từ "expose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Virtual filesystems exposing kernel and process state — not on disk", what does "expose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (động từ): phơi ra, cung cấp ra. "Expose an API/port" = cung cấp ra bên ngoài để truy cập.
items.explanationEn: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (verb): to make available or visible. "Expose an API/port" means making it reachable from outside.

items.question: Trong câu "/proc/<pid>/ shows a process's command line, limits and open file descriptors; /proc/meminfo feeds free.", từ "feed" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "/proc/<pid>/ shows a process's command line, limits and open file descriptors; /proc/meminfo feeds free.", what does "feed" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: feed /fiːd/ (động từ): cung cấp dữ liệu cho. "X feeds Y" = X cung cấp dữ liệu đầu vào cho Y; danh từ "feed" là nguồn tin.
items.explanationEn: feed /fiːd/ (verb): to supply data to. "X feeds Y" means X supplies input to Y; the noun "feed" is a stream of data.

items.question: Trong câu "A filesystem has a fixed number of inodes", từ "fixed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A filesystem has a fixed number of inodes", what does "fixed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fixed /fɪkst/ (tính từ): cố định, không đổi. "A fixed number" = số lượng cố định; "fixed bug" lại là lỗi đã sửa.
items.explanationEn: fixed /fɪkst/ (adjective): set and unchanging. "A fixed number" is a set amount; "a fixed bug" instead means a repaired one.

items.question: Trong câu "so millions of tiny files (session files, cache shards) can make a disk", từ "shard" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "so millions of tiny files (session files, cache shards) can make a disk", what does "shard" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: shard /ʃɑːd/ (danh từ): phần dữ liệu chia nhỏ. "Shard" trong dữ liệu là một phần được chia ra; động từ "shard" là phân mảnh.
items.explanationEn: shard /ʃɑːd/ (noun): a split-off part of data. In data, a "shard" is one partition of a larger set; "sharding" is splitting it.

items.question: Trong câu "Architecture habit: put state that must survive (database files, uploads) on a separate volume", từ "survive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Architecture habit: put state that must survive (database files, uploads) on a separate volume", what does "survive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: survive /səˈvaɪv/ (động từ): vẫn còn lại sau. "Survive a reboot" = vẫn còn sau khi khởi động lại.
items.explanationEn: survive /səˈvaɪv/ (verb): to remain after. "Survive a reboot" means still existing after a restart.

items.question: Trong câu "Architecture habit: put state that must survive (database files, uploads) on a separate volume", từ "habit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Architecture habit: put state that must survive (database files, uploads) on a separate volume", what does "habit" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: habit /ˈhæbɪt/ (danh từ): thói quen. "A good habit" = thói quen tốt; "make a habit of" = tập thành thói quen.
items.explanationEn: habit /ˈhæbɪt/ (noun): a regular practice. "A good habit" is a regular good practice; "make a habit of" means doing it regularly.

items.question: Trong câu "Every process runs as a user (UID) with one primary and several supplementary groups (GIDs).", từ "supplementary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every process runs as a user (UID) with one primary and several supplementary groups (GIDs).", what does "supplementary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: supplementary /ˌsʌplɪˈmentri/ (tính từ): bổ sung, phụ thêm. "Supplementary groups" = các nhóm phụ ngoài nhóm chính (primary).
items.explanationEn: supplementary /ˌsʌplɪˈmentri/ (adjective): additional, extra. "Supplementary groups" are extra groups besides the primary one.

items.question: Trong câu "UID 0 is root and bypasses normal permission checks.", từ "bypass" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "UID 0 is root and bypasses normal permission checks.", what does "bypass" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bypass /ˈbaɪpɑːs/ (động từ): bỏ qua, đi vòng qua. "Bypass a check" = bỏ qua bước kiểm tra; danh từ "bypass" còn là đường vòng.
items.explanationEn: bypass /ˈbaɪpɑːs/ (verb): to go around, skip. "Bypass a check" means skipping it; the noun "bypass" is also a road around a town.

items.question: Trong câu "Each file has an owner, a group and three permission triplets", từ "triplet" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each file has an owner, a group and three permission triplets", what does "triplet" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: triplet /ˈtrɪplət/ (danh từ): bộ ba. Mỗi "triplet" rwx gồm ba bit quyền; nghĩa khác là một trong ba đứa trẻ sinh ba.
items.explanationEn: triplet /ˈtrɪplət/ (noun): a set of three. Each rwx "triplet" has three permission bits; it can also mean one of three children born together.

items.question: Trong câu "sudo grants controlled, audited privilege escalation; edit its rules with visudo.", từ "audit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "sudo grants controlled, audited privilege escalation; edit its rules with visudo.", what does "audit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: audit /ˈɔːdɪt/ (động từ): kiểm tra, ghi vết. "Audited access" = truy cập được ghi lại để kiểm tra; "audit log" = nhật ký kiểm toán.
items.explanationEn: audit /ˈɔːdɪt/ (verb): to inspect and record. "Audited access" is recorded for later review; an "audit log" keeps that record.

items.question: Trong câu "sudo grants controlled, audited privilege escalation; edit its rules with visudo.", từ "escalation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "sudo grants controlled, audited privilege escalation; edit its rules with visudo.", what does "escalation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: escalation /ˌeskəˈleɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự nâng lên. "Privilege escalation" = nâng quyền; "escalate an issue" = chuyển vấn đề lên cấp cao hơn.
items.explanationEn: escalation /ˌeskəˈleɪʃn/ (noun): an increase in level. "Privilege escalation" means gaining higher rights; "escalate an issue" means raising it to a higher level.

items.question: Trong câu "Least privilege in practice: each service gets its own system user with no login shell", từ "privilege" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Least privilege in practice: each service gets its own system user with no login shell", what does "privilege" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: privilege /ˈprɪvəlɪdʒ/ (danh từ): quyền hạn truy cập. "Least privilege" = chỉ cấp quyền tối thiểu cần thiết.
items.explanationEn: privilege /ˈprɪvəlɪdʒ/ (noun): a right to access. "Least privilege" means granting only the minimum rights needed.

items.question: Trong câu "Least privilege in practice: each service gets its own system user with no login shell", từ "in practice" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Least privilege in practice: each service gets its own system user with no login shell", what does "in practice" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in practice /ɪn ˈpræktɪs/ (cụm từ): trong thực tế. "In practice" = khi áp dụng thực tế, đối lập với "in theory".
items.explanationEn: in practice /ɪn ˈpræktɪs/ (phrase): in real use. "In practice" means in real application, as opposed to "in theory".

items.question: Trong câu "Ports below 1024 do not require root either — grant CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE or put a reverse proxy in front.", từ "grant" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ports below 1024 do not require root either — grant CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE or put a reverse proxy in front.", what does "grant" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: grant /ɡrɑːnt/ (động từ): cấp, trao (quyền). "Grant permission/access" = cấp quyền; danh từ "grant" là khoản tài trợ.
items.explanationEn: grant /ɡrɑːnt/ (verb): to give a right. "Grant permission/access" means giving it; the noun "grant" is a sum of funding.

items.question: Trong câu "It starts services in dependency order, restarts them on crash, puts each in its own cgroup and captures their output.", từ "dependency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It starts services in dependency order, restarts them on crash, puts each in its own cgroup and captures their output.", what does "dependency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: dependency /dɪˈpendənsi/ (danh từ): sự phụ thuộc. "Dependency order" = thứ tự theo quan hệ phụ thuộc; cái được phụ thuộc chạy trước.
items.explanationEn: dependency /dɪˈpendənsi/ (noun): reliance on something. "Dependency order" means starting what others rely on first.

items.question: Trong câu "It starts services in dependency order, restarts them on crash, puts each in its own cgroup and captures their output.", từ "capture" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It starts services in dependency order, restarts them on crash, puts each in its own cgroup and captures their output.", what does "capture" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: capture /ˈkæptʃə/ (động từ): thu lại, ghi lại. "Capture output" = thu lại đầu ra; "capture a screenshot" = chụp màn hình.
items.explanationEn: capture /ˈkæptʃə/ (verb): to collect and record. "Capture output" means collecting it; "capture a screenshot" means taking one.

items.question: Trong câu "After editing a unit, forget daemon-reload and systemd keeps using the old definition.", từ "definition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After editing a unit, forget daemon-reload and systemd keeps using the old definition.", what does "definition" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: definition /ˌdefɪˈnɪʃn/ (danh từ): bản mô tả cấu hình. "The old definition" ở đây là bản khai báo unit cũ; "high definition" là độ nét cao.
items.explanationEn: definition /ˌdefɪˈnɪʃn/ (noun): a description of a configuration. "The old definition" here is the previous unit declaration; "high definition" is image sharpness.

items.question: Trong câu "Restart=on-failure restarts after unclean exits (non-zero exit code, killed by an unexpected signal, timeout)", từ "unclean" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Restart=on-failure restarts after unclean exits (non-zero exit code, killed by an unexpected signal, timeout)", what does "unclean" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unclean /ʌnˈkliːn/ (tính từ): không êm, bất thường. "Unclean exit" = thoát bất thường (lỗi, bị kill), trái với "clean exit".
items.explanationEn: unclean /ʌnˈkliːn/ (adjective): not orderly, abnormal. An "unclean exit" is an abnormal one (error, killed), the opposite of a "clean exit".

items.question: Trong câu "systemd's journald collects stdout/stderr of every service, kernel messages and syslog into an indexed binary journal.", từ "indexed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "systemd's journald collects stdout/stderr of every service, kernel messages and syslog into an indexed binary journal.", what does "indexed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: indexed /ˈɪndekst/ (tính từ): được lập chỉ mục. "Indexed" = có chỉ mục để tìm kiếm nhanh, như index trong database.
items.explanationEn: indexed /ˈɪndekst/ (adjective): organized for fast lookup. "Indexed" means organized for fast searching, like a database index.

items.question: Trong câu "A container is a normal process that the kernel limits with cgroups and isolates with namespaces, plus a separate root filesystem.", từ "isolate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A container is a normal process that the kernel limits with cgroups and isolates with namespaces, plus a separate root filesystem.", what does "isolate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: isolate /ˈaɪsəleɪt/ (động từ): tách biệt, cô lập. "Isolate processes" = tách để chúng không nhìn thấy nhau; danh từ "isolation".
items.explanationEn: isolate /ˈaɪsəleɪt/ (verb): to keep separate. "Isolate processes" means keeping them from seeing each other; the noun is "isolation".

items.question: Trong câu "cgroups (control groups) meter and cap CPU, memory, block I/O and PID count for a group of processes.", từ "meter" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "cgroups (control groups) meter and cap CPU, memory, block I/O and PID count for a group of processes.", what does "meter" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: meter /ˈmiːtə/ (động từ): đo lường mức dùng. "Meter usage" = đo mức sử dụng, như đồng hồ điện nước.
items.explanationEn: meter /ˈmiːtə/ (verb): to measure usage. "Meter usage" means measuring consumption, like a utility meter.

items.question: Trong câu "Namespaces give a process its own view of a global resource", từ "global" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Namespaces give a process its own view of a global resource", what does "global" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: global /ˈɡləʊbl/ (tính từ): toàn cục (cả hệ thống). "Global resource" = tài nguyên dùng chung toàn hệ thống; "global variable" = biến toàn cục.
items.explanationEn: global /ˈɡləʊbl/ (adjective): system-wide. A "global resource" is shared across the system; compare "global variable".

items.question: Trong câu "user (UID mapping — root inside, unprivileged outside)", từ "unprivileged" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "user (UID mapping — root inside, unprivileged outside)", what does "unprivileged" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unprivileged /ʌnˈprɪvəlɪdʒd/ (tính từ): không có quyền cao. "Unprivileged user" = người dùng thường, không có quyền root.
items.explanationEn: unprivileged /ʌnˈprɪvəlɪdʒd/ (adjective): without special rights. An "unprivileged user" is an ordinary user without root rights.

items.question: Trong câu "Consequences: containers share the host kernel, so a kernel exploit crosses container boundaries", từ "consequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Consequences: containers share the host kernel, so a kernel exploit crosses container boundaries", what does "consequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consequence /ˈkɒnsɪkwəns/ (danh từ): hệ quả. "As a consequence" = do đó; "of no consequence" lại là không quan trọng.
items.explanationEn: consequence /ˈkɒnsɪkwəns/ (noun): a result. "As a consequence" means as a result; "of no consequence" means unimportant.

items.question: Trong câu "Consequences: containers share the host kernel, so a kernel exploit crosses container boundaries", từ "exploit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Consequences: containers share the host kernel, so a kernel exploit crosses container boundaries", what does "exploit" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: exploit /ˈeksplɔɪt/ (danh từ): mã khai thác lỗ hổng. "Kernel exploit" = cách tấn công lợi dụng lỗ hổng kernel; động từ "exploit" = khai thác.
items.explanationEn: exploit /ˈeksplɔɪt/ (noun): code that abuses a flaw. A "kernel exploit" abuses a kernel flaw; the verb "exploit" means to take advantage of.

items.question: Trong câu "Consequences: containers share the host kernel, so a kernel exploit crosses container boundaries", từ "boundary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Consequences: containers share the host kernel, so a kernel exploit crosses container boundaries", what does "boundary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: boundary /ˈbaʊndri/ (danh từ): ranh giới. "Security boundary" = ranh giới cách ly; "cross a boundary" = vượt ranh giới.
items.explanationEn: boundary /ˈbaʊndri/ (noun): a dividing limit. A "security boundary" separates trust zones; "cross a boundary" means going past it.

items.question: Trong câu "Containers are Linux processes constrained by cgroups (how much) and namespaces (what they see), sharing the host kernel.", từ "constrain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Containers are Linux processes constrained by cgroups (how much) and namespaces (what they see), sharing the host kernel.", what does "constrain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: constrain /kənˈstreɪn/ (động từ): giới hạn, ràng buộc. "Constrained by X" = bị X giới hạn; danh từ "constraint" = ràng buộc.
items.explanationEn: constrain /kənˈstreɪn/ (verb): to restrict. "Constrained by X" means limited by X; the noun is "constraint".

items.question: Trong câu "free is misleading; watch available.", từ "misleading" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "free is misleading; watch available.", what does "misleading" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: misleading /ˌmɪsˈliːdɪŋ/ (tính từ): gây hiểu lầm. "Misleading number" = con số dễ khiến hiểu sai tình trạng thật.
items.explanationEn: misleading /ˌmɪsˈliːdɪŋ/ (adjective): giving a wrong idea. A "misleading number" makes you misjudge the real situation.

items.question: Trong câu "High load + high wa = I/O bottleneck.", từ "bottleneck" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "High load + high wa = I/O bottleneck.", what does "bottleneck" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: bottleneck /ˈbɒtlnek/ (danh từ): điểm nghẽn hiệu năng. "I/O bottleneck" = điểm nghẽn do đọc/ghi đĩa chậm, kìm cả hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: bottleneck /ˈbɒtlnek/ (noun): a point that limits throughput. An "I/O bottleneck" is slow disk access holding back the whole system.

items.question: Trong câu "with free space → inodes exhausted", từ "exhausted" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "with free space → inodes exhausted", what does "exhausted" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: exhausted /ɪɡˈzɔːstɪd/ (tính từ): đã dùng hết. "Resources exhausted" = tài nguyên đã cạn; với người là mệt lả.
items.explanationEn: exhausted /ɪɡˈzɔːstɪd/ (adjective): completely used up. "Resources exhausted" means none are left; for people it means very tired.

items.question: Trong câu "Bake images for reproducibility, but rebuild them to keep patching.", từ "reproducibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bake images for reproducibility, but rebuild them to keep patching.", what does "reproducibility" (noun) mean?
options: khả năng tái tạo y hệt
items.explanation: reproducibility /rɪˌprəʊdjuːsəˈbɪləti/ (danh từ): khả năng tái tạo y hệt. "Reproducibility" = dựng lại lần nào cũng ra kết quả giống nhau.
items.explanationEn: reproducibility /rɪˌprəʊdjuːsəˈbɪləti/ (noun): ability to recreate identically. "Reproducibility" means getting the same result every time you rebuild.

items.question: Trong câu "The filesystem hierarchy separates config (/etc), state and logs (/var), programs (/usr) and kernel views (/proc, /sys).", từ "hierarchy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The filesystem hierarchy separates config (/etc), state and logs (/var), programs (/usr) and kernel views (/proc, /sys).", what does "hierarchy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hierarchy /ˈhaɪərɑːki/ (danh từ): cấu trúc phân cấp. "Filesystem hierarchy" = cấu trúc thư mục phân cấp dạng cây.
items.explanationEn: hierarchy /ˈhaɪərɑːki/ (noun): a tree-like structure of levels. The "filesystem hierarchy" is the tree of nested directories.
